{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=16|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****[[United States Secretary of Defense|United States defense secretary]] [[Pete Hegseth]] says that the [[United States|U.S.]] is prepared to resume combat operations if [[Iran]] does not agree to a permanent deal. [https://aje.news/060cxq?update=4497301 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire]]
*****[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that [[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]] have agreed to a 10-day [[ceasefire]], after his [[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks|conversations]] with [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and [[President of Lebanon|Lebanese president]] [[Joseph Aoun]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/live-updates-iran-war-israel-lebanon-leaders-talks-ceasefire-trump-rcna332095/rcrd108141?canonicalCard=true (NBC News)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]] 
**[[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile and [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]], including on [[Kyiv]] and [[Odesa]], kill at least 22 people and wound more than 131 others. [https://kyivindependent.com/at-least-21-killed-131-injured-in-russian-strikes-across-ukraine-over-past-day/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian defence ministry]] publishes a list of locations in [[Europe]] that are reportedly supporting drone production for Ukraine, including in [[Germany]] and [[Italy]], saying the locations are "potential targets for the [[Russian Armed Forces]]”. [https://www.euractiv.com/news/russia-threatens-european-drone-producers-publishes-addresses-online/ (''Euractiv'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[United States intervention in Syria]]
***[[United States Armed Forces|U.S. troops]] complete their withdrawal from the Qasrak air base in [[Hasakah Governorate|Hasakah]] [[Governorates of Syria|province]], ending U.S. involvement in [[Syria]] after troops first arrived in 2015 to fight against the [[Islamic State]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/us-military-fully-withdraws-syria-after-10-years (''Middle East Eye'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/16/world/middleeast/us-handover-military-bases-syria.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Five gunmen are killed and a [[state trooper]] is wounded during a security operation in [[Los Herreras]], [[Nuevo León]], [[Mexico]]. Authorities implement coordinated surveillance in the area for more suspects. [https://www.milenio.com/policia/enfrentamiento-los-herrera-5-delincuentes-abatidos-un-oficial-herido (''Milenio'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*A previously unknown poem by [[Federico García Lorca]] is found handwritten on the back of a manuscript. It was discovered by [[Spain|Spanish]] singer and collector [[Miguel Poveda]]. [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20260416/miguel-poveda-descubre-poema-lorca-inedito-manuscrito/17026102.shtml (RTVE <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*A mystery location of [[William Shakespeare|Shakespeare's]] [[London]] house finally uncovered. [https://www.euronews.com/culture/2026/04/16/new-discovery-solves-mystery-of-the-location-of-shakespeares-london-house (Euronews)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Germany|German]] airline [[Lufthansa]] announces the permanent withdrawal of 27 aircraft operated by its [[Lufthansa CityLine|CityLine]] regional subsidiary and plans additional [[Lufthansa fleet|fleet]] reductions, citing increased fuel costs linked to the Iran war and labor disruptions. [https://english.news.cn/europe/20260416/3003e493367c4a129dde3454f4757337/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and accidents''' 
*Approximately 18 people are killed when a [[minibus]] catches fire on a highway near [[Bulawayo]], [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://apnews.com/article/zimbabwe-minibus-taxi-fatal-fire-c8c13f06118dee72ee86aaec59a72fa0 (AP)]
*A helicopter crashes in [[Sekadau Regency]], [[West Kalimantan]], [[Indonesia]], killing all eight people on board. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/eight-people-killed-helicopter-crash-indonesias-west-kalimantan-authorities-say-2026-04-17/ (Reuters)]
*A fire at the major [[Viva Energy|Viva]] oil [[refinery]] near [[Melbourne]], [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]], halts its [[Energy in Australia|gasoline production]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-04-15/-significant-fire-at-viva-energy-s-geelong-refinery-video (Bloomberg)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Israel relations]], [[Status of Jerusalem]]
**[[Argentina|Argentine]] [[President of Argentina|president]] [[Javier Milei]] announces a trip to Israel where he is expected to receive the [[Israeli Presidential Medal of Honor]] and meet [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to expedite the transfer of the [[List of diplomatic missions of Argentina|Argentine embassy]] from [[Tel Aviv]] to [[Jerusalem]]. [https://www.infobae.com/politica/2026/04/16/milei-reitero-su-respaldo-a-israel-en-la-guerra-frente-a-iran-y-cuestiono-a-la-comunidad-internacional-son-cobardes/ (''Infobae'')]
*[[Venezuela and the International Monetary Fund]]
**The [[International Monetary Fund]] and the [[World Bank]] restore official relations with [[Venezuela]] and recognize the administration of acting [[President of Venezuela|president]] [[Delcy Rodríguez]], enabling engagement on [[Economy of Venezuela|economic policy]] and potential [[Foreign aid to Venezuela|financial assistance]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260417-imf-world-bank-say-restoring-relations-with-venezuela-recognizing-interim-government (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Onikişubat school shooting]]
**The death toll in yesterday's [[school shooting]] in [[Onikişubat]], [[Kahramanmaraş Province]], [[Turkey]], rises to 11, including the perpetrator, after a critically injured victim succumbs to his injuries. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-school-shootings-kahramanmaras-sanliurfa-5f3332b3242a64e9d2e6a3ba58072c05 (AP)]
*[[Death of Celeste Rivas Hernandez]]
**[[Los Angeles Police Department|Police]] arrest singer [[d4vd]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]], U.S., on suspicion of killing a 14-year-old girl whose remains were previously found in a vehicle registered to him. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20d22ev21wo (BBC News)]
*[[Flood control projects scandal in the Philippines]]
**[[Philippines|Philippine]] [[President of the Philippines|president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] says that [[Czech Republic|Czech]] authorities have arrested former [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|legislator]] [[Zaldy Co]] in [[Prague]] after he entered the country without proper documentation, following his designation as a [[fugitive]] in connection with [[Graft (politics)|graft]] and [[Malfeasance in office|malversation]] charges linked to a [[flood control]] project. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-flood-control-corruption-scandal-d9d498175e883974312cacf62585ea8b (AP)]
*[[Trafficking of Chinese nationals to scam centers abroad]]
**[[Sri Lanka]]n [[Sri Lanka Customs|customs]] officials arrest nine [[Chinese people in Sri Lanka|Chinese nationals]] at [[Bandaranaike International Airport]] in [[Colombo]] for attempting to smuggle communication equipment concealed on their bodies, which officials say is intended for use in [[internet fraud]] operations. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/sri-lanka-arrests-nine-chinese-smuggle-cyberscam-equipment-6060176 (AFP via CNA)]
*[[2025 United Kingdom anti-immigration protests|United Kingdom anti-immigration protests]]
**[[Surrey Police]] issue a disorder warning in [[Epsom]], [[England]], after protesters clash with [[riot police]] in the town. The protesters are demanding the description of men who [[gang rape]]d a woman outside a [[Methodism|Methodist Church]] the previous weekend. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c77m5nvyz7vo (BBC News)]
*In [[South Africa]], [[Economic Freedom Fighters]] leader [[Julius Malema]] is sentenced to five years [[Prisons in South Africa|imprisonment]] for the unlawful discharge of a firearm at a 2018 rally. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260416-s-african-left-wing-leader-malema-sentenced-to-five-years-jail-on-gun-charges (AFP via France 24)]
*In the United States, [[Fairfax County, Virginia|Fairfax County]] officials say that former [[Virginia]] [[Lieutenant Governor of Virginia|lieutenant governor]] [[Justin Fairfax]] [[Murder in United States law|murdered]] his wife, then killed himself, after [[Fairfax County Police Department|police]] find them dead at their home. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/justin-fairfax-family-who-is-wife-cerina-fairfax-and-children-gruesome-murder-details-out-101776350728183.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Hungarian parliamentary election]]
**[[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[Prime Minister of Hungary|prime minister]]-designate [[Péter Magyar]] says his election victory over [[Viktor Orbán]] will not lead to a policy shift on migration, saying his government will strengthen borders and "protect our country and [[Europe]]" from [[illegal immigration]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/hungary-pm-magyar-takes-aim-at-eu-tough-border-policy-11836681 (Newsweek)]
*[[Corruption in Nepal]]
**The [[Balen Shah cabinet]] establishes a five-member commission, led by a former [[Supreme Court of Nepal|Supreme Court]] judge, to investigate the assets of current and former [[Nepal]]i [[Politics of Nepal|public officials]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/04/17/world/asia-oceania/nepali-govt-forms-panel-to-probe-politicians-assets/2321751 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[U.S. House of Representatives]] rejects the [[War Powers Resolution]] to stop military operations by a 214–213 vote. [https://www.politico.com/news/2026/04/16/house-rejects-trump-limits-iran-war-00876707 (''Politico'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Candidates Tournament 2026]]
**In [[chess]], [[Javokhir Sindarov]] wins the [[Candidates Tournament]] in [[Cyprus]]. The [[Women's Candidates Tournament 2026|Women's Tournament]] is won by [[Vaishali Rameshbabu]]. [https://www.fide.com/vaishali-conquers-womens-candidates-to-set-up-world-title-showdown-against-ju-wenjun/ (''FIDE'')]
